sentences.text: Nico y Sam juegan un juego.
sentences.english: Nico and Sam are playing a game.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Yo digo cómo es una mujer.
sentences.english: I say what a woman is like.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Vos tenés que saber el nombre.
sentences.english: You have to know the name.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Es una mujer alta y delgada.
sentences.english: She is a tall, thin woman.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Sí, es muy amable y muy simpática.
sentences.english: Yes, she is very kind and very nice.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Does she work at the clinic?

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Y anteayer bailó en la fiesta.
sentences.english: And the day before yesterday she danced at the party.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Es alto, pero no es delgado.
sentences.english: He is tall, but he is not thin.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Sí, es simpático y es amable.
sentences.english: Yes, he is nice and kind.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Sos muy bueno en este juego.
sentences.english: You are very good at this game.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Es la casa de doña Marta.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Tu mochila es verde, y mi mochila es azul.
sentences.english: Your school bag is green, and my school bag is blue.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Mi cuarto es azul y limpio.
sentences.english: My room is blue and clean.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.english: Maybe you understand the game now.

sentences.text: Corta el tomate y la cebolla, calienta el aceite y fríe la tortilla de harina.
sentences.english: She cuts the tomato and the onion, heats the oil and fries the flour tortilla.

sentences.text: Agrega sal y pone el queso y la crema con una cuchara.
sentences.english: She adds salt and puts the cheese and the cream on with a spoon.

sentences.text: El frijol es negro y el tomate es rojo.
sentences.english: The bean is black and the tomato is red.

sentences.text: El queso es blanco y la crema es blanca.
sentences.english: The cheese is white and the cream is white.

sentences.text: La verdura es verde, y el plato es azul.
sentences.english: The vegetables are green, and the plate is blue.
It is a very pretty baleada.

sentences.text: La noche es negra, pero la baleada es buena.
sentences.english: The night is black, but the baleada is good.

sentences.text: Doña Marta dice: "Una baleada es una fiesta para los ojos."
sentences.english: Doña Marta says: "A baleada is a party for the eyes."

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Luis es más alto que Ana.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Y doña Marta es más vieja que todos.
sentences.english: And doña Marta is older than everybody.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Vos sos más pequeño que yo, pero sos un niño.
sentences.english: You are smaller than I am, but you are a child.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Y vos sos más viejo que yo.
sentences.english: And you are older than I am.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Pero doña Marta tiene más edad que todos.
sentences.english: But doña Marta is older than everybody.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: El cuarto de la abuela es más limpio que la terminal.
sentences.english: Grandmother's room is cleaner than the terminal.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Y el parque es más bonito que la calle.
sentences.english: And the park is prettier than the street.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: La terminal es fea, pero el mercado es más feo.
sentences.english: The terminal is ugly, but the market is uglier.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Nico, el mercado tiene mucha gente buena.
sentences.english: Nico, the market has many good people.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.english: Well, it is only a game.

sentences.text: Mañana llega Karla a la terminal.
sentences.english: Tomorrow Karla arrives at the terminal.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Are you going to the terminal?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Es una mujer joven y feliz.
sentences.english: She is a young and happy woman.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Tiene una mochila grande y una bolsa roja.
sentences.english: She has a big school bag and a red bag.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Sí, tiene menos edad que yo.
sentences.english: Yes, she is younger than I am.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Está bien, pero quizás está cansada del viaje.
sentences.english: She is fine, but maybe she is tired from the trip.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Then we take water and bread.

sentences.text: Doña Marta es una mujer vieja, pero tiene el corazón joven.
sentences.english: Doña Marta is an old woman, but she has a young heart.

sentences.text: Su esposo Miguel murió hace ocho años.
sentences.english: Her husband Miguel died eight years ago.

sentences.text: Ahora tiene dos nietos, Nico y una niña pequeña.
sentences.english: Now she has two grandchildren, Nico and a little girl.

sentences.text: Ana nació en el pueblo y creció en la casa de su mamá.
sentences.english: Ana was born in the village and grew up in her mother's house.

sentences.text: Luis se casó hace dos años, y su esposa trabaja en la escuela.
sentences.english: Luis got married two years ago, and his wife works at the school.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Estar triste es solo un momento.
sentences.english: Being sad is only for a moment.

sentences.text: Doña Marta es buena, y Sam es feliz en su casa.
sentences.english: Doña Marta is good, and Sam is happy in her house.

sentences.text: Después, Sam escribe un mensaje a su familia.
sentences.english: Afterwards, Sam writes a message to his family.

sentences.text: Doña Marta es una mujer buena.
sentences.english: Doña Marta is a good woman.

sentences.text: Dice también: "Mi cuarto es pequeño, pero tiene mucha paz."
sentences.english: He also says: "My room is small, but it has a lot of peace."
